businessGoal: Allow users to filter products by brand to improve product discoverability.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the brand filter is displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that selecting one or more brand checkboxes updates the product grid to show only products from the selected brands.
Verify that selecting both categories and brands updates the product grid to show products matching both filters.

manual.reason: The story involves visible UI interactions and behaviors.

api.reason: The story does not specify any API interactions or capabilities.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behavior and interactions.
